scripts.test: npm run test:frontend && npm run test:backend
scripts.build: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build
scripts.version: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.writeFileSync('VERSION', process.env.npm_package_version + '\n'); const m = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('extension/manifest.json')); m.version = process.env.npm_package_version; fs.writeFileSync('extension/manifest.json', JSON.stringify(m, null, 2) + '\n');" && git add VERSION extension/manifest.json
